shots.setup: G.filmCam = null; if (window.__d && G.ember.champions().endDuel) { G.ember.champions().endDuel(); window.__d = null; } G.champ = null; for (const k in (G.bosses||{})) { const b = G.bosses[k]; if (b.active && b.stop) b.stop(); } G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); for (const q of (G.enemies.encounters || [])) q.cleared = true; { const SP = G.combat.powers && G.combat.powers.spout; if (SP && SP.clear) SP.clear(); } { const h0 = G.hero; h0.carried = null; if (h0.endFly) h0.endFly(); h0.fly = false; h0.glide = false; h0.fireAir = false; } if (window.__keep) { G.combat.data.champions.phases.forEach((p, i) => (p.moves = window.__keep[i])); window.__keep = null; } window.__want = null; window.__to = null; window.__orb = null; G.ember.setSide('fire', { place: false, quiet: true }); { const h0 = G.hero; if (h0.endFly) h0.endFly(); h0.fly = false; h0.fireAir = false; } const h = G.hero, V = h.pos.constructor; h.hp = h.maxHp = 900; h.tide = h.maxTide = 100; for (const k in h.powers) h.powers[k] = true; h.inv = 1e6; window.__n = 0; if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.42); Q.walkAt(246, -760); G.camYaw = 0.6; { const fx = Math.sin(G.camYaw), fz = Math.cos(G.camYaw), rx = -fz, rz = fx; for (const [k, a, b] of [['newt', 6, -2], ['monitor', 8.5, 2], ['newt', 7, 4]]) { const x = h.pos.x + fx * a + rx * b, z = h.pos.z + fz * a + rz * b; G.enemies.spawn(k, new V(x, h.pos.y, z)); } } __rig.hero({ dist: 5.2, up: 0.8, ang: Math.PI - 0.75, look: [1.2, 0.8], fov: 60, k: 8 }); 'ok'
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; h.tide = h.maxTide; h.boostFuel = 1; for (const e of G.enemies.alive()) if (e.hp < 60) e.hp = 250; const P = {10:'spin', 40:'atk', 50:'atk', 60:'atk', 80:'wave'}; const w = { mx: 0, my: 0, ud: 0 }; if (n === 1 && window.__want && h.stance !== window.__want) w.stance = true;  if (P[n]) w[P[n]] = true; Q.drive(w);
